scoring_method.carried_from: accepted pilot pilot/B40_portfolio/attempt-1/DECISION.json - scale, uncertainty bands, aggregation, weights, criteria definitions, and anti-double-counting lines carried verbatim; refinements disclosed in PORTFOLIO.md section 3 (none to weights, scale, or definitions; base-score tie-handling judgments now required and stated per tie).
scoring_method.scale: Coarse ordinal 0-4 per criterion: 0 = blocking/strongly adverse; 1 = weak/unfavorable; 2 = mixed/neutral; 3 = favorable; 4 = strongly favorable. No finer granularity claimed.
scoring_method.uncertainty: Per-criterion half-width bands: 0.5 (well-evidenced incl. A30-verified or demonstrated-ledger facts), 1.0 (record-level/corpus-dated or proposed-only mechanisms), 1.5 (pool-record-only; unused among the 24 because all pool-record-only concepts were rejected). Aggregate uncertainty = sum of weight x half-width (conservative linear combination). Overlapping aggregate bands mean adjacent ranks are not separated; dispositions rest on gate logic, not score decimals.
scoring_method.aggregation: score = sum(weight_i x score_i); two decimals retained here strictly for ordering audit, one decimal in RANKING.csv.

weights_declared.design_note: Commercial-evidence side 0.60, founder side 0.30, downside 0.10 - PhD leverage (0.12) structurally cannot override commercial evidence (the task's judgment rule as arithmetic).

scoring_method.criteria_definitions: Carried verbatim from the pilot DECISION.json criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_counting block (founder_goal_fit = plan compatibility under C42/C33/C34/C49; phd_leverage = B20 mechanism class, not re-derived; shared_skills = B30 acquisition/bridge-path position; geography = market friction only; regulation = burden incl. person-status; downside = failure severity; technical_proof/buyer_access/defensibility = commercial evidence state).
scoring_method.semantic_double_counting_guard: A30 SEM ledger governs: E-01 inside C-01 (SEM-01), B-01 inside C-04 (SEM-02) - origin cells only; E-10/A-13 (SEM-03) and C-15/A-21 (SEM-04) both rejected as concepts; NON-MATCH-C14 kept C-14 distinct from A-22 (both rejected).

disposition_vocabulary.keep: Commercial and founder evidence both support active pursuit now; no blocking gate; primary venture-preparation time.
disposition_vocabulary.bridge: Retained conditional on named B30 bridge-experiment gates; the ONLY permitted founder spend is executing those gates; gate outcomes promote (toward keep) or demote (to watch/stop).
disposition_vocabulary.watch: No founder time beyond monitoring named external triggers; re-evaluate at the named trigger or at the next portfolio review.
disposition_vocabulary.stop: No further founder time in any form; leaves active consideration (record retained). A ranked idea can be a stop: rank records integrated evidence quality, disposition records the founder decision.
disposition_vocabulary.finding: No idea earns keep in the full 24 - confirmed at full scale, not only in the pilot sample: every non-WEAK mechanism in the universe runs through proposed-only capabilities gated by C04 and FT-02 (B30's conclusion), so the portfolio's top is bridge-shaped by construction.
